channel.title: The Grant Desk - Prizes and Awards, AI, Tech & Research, Remote & Worldwide, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Prizes and Awards, AI, Tech & Research, Remote & Worldwide, weekly digest. Released weekly: the week's new grants arrive together on Sunday, one entry per grant plus a short roundup header, instead of trickling out daily.

item.title: 1 new AI, Tech & Research prize - week of 27 Jul 2026
item.description:
• Berggruen Prize Essay Competition 2026: A New Axial Age?
    https://berggruen.org/eu/essay-competition-open
    Berggruen Institute · deadline Closed 17 Aug 2026 · USD 50,000 for the winning English essay and USD 50,000 for the winning Chinese essay. If there is more than one winner in a language category, the prize is split evenly. Winning essays are published through BI Press or Noema. No entry fee.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).

item.title: 2 new AI, Tech & Research prizes - week of 25 May 2026
item.description:
• Reply AI Film Festival 2026
    https://challenges.reply.com/challenges/creative/aifilmfestival/detail/
    Reply · deadline Closed 01 Jun 2026 · First prize EUR 8,000, second prize EUR 5,000, third prize EUR 2,000 (total prize pool EUR 30,000+), plus travel and 2-night Venice accommodation for finalists. No submission fee.
  • AI Futures Challenge 2026 (Worldbuilding Competition)
    https://worlds.existentialhope.com/
    Existential Hope (Foresight Institute) · deadline Closed 30 Jun 2026 · $10,000 prize pool: $5,000 for the best world plus five $1,000 bounties. No entry fee.
